name: Folloze Skills Weekly Update
summary: Pull/install-only weekly refresh of reviewed Folloze internal skills from a clean sync clone.
cwd_hint: Use the teammate's home directory as the workspace root.
prompt: Run the installed skills-update-folloze helper to pull and install only the reviewed skills enabled in skills-manifest.json. Prefer FOLLOZE_SKILLS_REPO_ROOT, FOLLOZE_SKILLS_SYNC_REPO_ROOT, FOLLOZE_SKILLS_REPO_URL, and FOLLOZE_SKILLS_REPO_BRANCH when configured. If the preferred development clone is dirty, ahead/diverged, detached, or on another branch, preserve it exactly and use the dedicated clean sync clone. Use copy mode so installed skills do not point at a development checkout. Do not discover, inspect, copy, stage, publish, commit, or push local skills. Do not clean, reset, switch, or repair the development checkout. Do not overwrite an unmanaged destination. Run the helper at ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/skills-update-folloze/scripts/update_folloze_skills.py. Return a short summary with the preserved development-clone status, exact sync clone, old and new commit IDs, refreshed skills or already-current status, any unmanaged destination requiring operator action, and whether Codex should restart.
